+import unittest
+
+from result_summary import summarize
+
+
+class SummarizeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_duplicate_identical_result_kept_once(self):
+        rows = [
+            {"run_id": "r1", "case_id": "c1", "status": "passed"},
+            {"run_id": "r1", "case_id": "c1", "status": "passed"},
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(summarize(rows), {"total": 1, "passed": 1})
+
+    def test_duplicate_status_reversal_keeps_last(self):
+        rows = [
+            {"run_id": "r1", "case_id": "c1", "status": "passed"},
+            {"run_id": "r1", "case_id": "c1", "status": "failed"},
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(summarize(rows), {"total": 1, "passed": 0})
+
+    def test_same_case_in_different_runs_counted_separately(self):
+        rows = [
+            {"run_id": "r1", "case_id": "c1", "status": "passed"},
+            {"run_id": "r2", "case_id": "c1", "status": "failed"},
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(summarize(rows), {"total": 2, "passed": 1})
+
+    def test_empty_input(self):
+        self.assertEqual(summarize([]), {"total": 0, "passed": 0})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
